scope: Bounded second-CI PR 572 follow-on review of one native Search chooser journey; preserve prior whole-file review and all remaining case-workspace journeys.

files.review: The second opening previously sent page-wide Escape immediately after a click, without observing native focus handoff. It now requires the actual search input to receive focus, sends one native Escape, requires the popup input to unmount and trigger aria-expanded to become false, and retains the original trigger-focus requirement. All earlier filter, no-match, clear-search focus, selected typed-property mutation, inspector, and new-row focus obligations are unchanged.

finding.observed: CI first-attempt screenshot and error context show the chooser still open, trigger aria-expanded=true, and search input focused after the lone Escape; this is not evidence of a closed popup failing to return focus. The same journey already required input focus after its first opening, but omitted this prerequisite on reopening.
finding.sourceEvidence: SearchableChoiceCombobox owns controlled open state and delegates keyboard/focus behavior to Base UI. Installed useDismiss closes only for committed open state and installs document listeners in an open-dependent effect. ComboboxPopup supplies its input as initial focus to FloatingFocusManager. The correction waits for this actual observable focus handoff rather than animation duration or a timer.
finding.limits: A diagnostic run of the unchanged journey with native focus/Escape observation and 6x Chromium CPU throttle passed. Thus local red reproduction was attempted but not obtained; the failed first CI attempt is the failure evidence. No new production defect was established.
